authority_rule: Mappings assign specialist reference roles for this reduced model only; they do not establish cellwise natural composition or Earth observational authority.

spatial_inventory.buck_target_support: UNKNOWN_NOT_SELECTED; B6N8-F section/support authority remains separate
spatial_inventory.projection: No resampling, interpolation, or spatial-resolution promotion is authorized by this mapping.

support_rows.support: native cells physical_crust_domain_id=2..6 with valid B-v2 continental thermal-class fields
support_rows.material_role: CONTINENTAL_CRUST_REFERENCE over authored crust thickness; LITHOSPHERIC_MANTLE_REFERENCE below crust to authored total model thickness
support_rows.vertical_geometry: crustal_thickness_m; total reference thickness by thermal class (200000/135000/80000 m); positive mantle residual required
support_rows.surface_boundary: exact authored q by thermal class: 0.045/0.060/0.085 W m-2; TSurf reference 280 K, sensitivity 250..300 K
support_rows.temporal_scope: T0 input; conditional frozen-configuration scenarios over T0-T1, not a physical history
support_rows.uncertainty: continental q numeric uncertainty UNKNOWN; TSurf range is parameter sensitivity, not probability
support_rows.eligibility: CONDITIONALLY_ELIGIBLE; exact native support only, valid geometry and source fields required

support_rows.support: native cells physical_crust_domain_id=1, positive age, valid HWR applicability and complete boundary/process support
support_rows.material_role: OCEANIC_CRUST_REFERENCE over authored ocean crust thickness; LITHOSPHERIC_MANTLE_REFERENCE under the selected HWR column mapping
support_rows.vertical_geometry: authored ocean crust thickness and HWR-derived effective profile/LAB under B6N8-J; reject nonpositive mantle residual
support_rows.surface_boundary: HWR-2 q(t) only for t>0 and only under explicit age/support adapter; finite-plate model configuration, not observed Earth field
support_rows.temporal_scope: conditional deterministic material-column age adapter; not Eulerian geology history or spreading law
support_rows.eligibility: CONDITIONALLY_ELIGIBLE; outside minimum continental Buck target unless selected later

support_rows.support: 108 selected ridge cells with authored ocean age exactly zero
support_rows.surface_boundary: authored q=0.3 W m-2; HWR is not evaluated at geological age zero; initializer uses derived effective age about 2.87057 Ma only as a profile index
support_rows.mapping: EXACT_EXISTING_MAPPING for T0 authored q and separate initializer rule; temporal adapter UNKNOWN
support_rows.eligibility: OUT_OF_SCOPE for T0-T1 provider envelope until an explicit ridge temporal rule is authorized

support_rows.support: 1072 positive-age ocean cells excluded by HWR support audit
support_rows.surface_boundary: not assigned by adjacency inference; HWR fail closed
support_rows.uncertainty: unclassified divergent-boundary adjacency and ridge-support overlap; preserve UNKNOWN

support_rows.material_role: CONTINENTAL_CRUST_REFERENCE only as reduced categorical branch role; not a compositional claim
support_rows.surface_boundary: continental thermal class only where that source class is present and valid
support_rows.temporal_scope: conditional frozen model-support scenario; physical land/ocean transition history UNKNOWN
support_rows.eligibility: CONDITIONALLY_ELIGIBLE only while all required categorical support and class joins are valid

property_applicability.sensitivity: Use only the already-governed per-role source intervals; do not cross-join independent extrema as a probability distribution.

property_applicability.relation: k/(rho*Cp) from the same coherent material tuple

property_applicability.sensitivity: existing material-reference ranges, including explicit zero endpoint where specified
existing 0..4e-8 W m-3 range; zero is an explicit sensitivity endpoint, never an implicit default

source_term_semantics.RADIOGENIC_HEAT: A_C/A_M are model source-term configuration by assigned reference material role; no cellwise geochemical field or temporal history is established.
source_term_semantics.SURFACE_HEAT_FLOW: boundary flux with branch-specific authority; not interchangeable with volumetric production
source_term_semantics.GEOTHERM: derived temperature profile; neither q nor A alone defines it

buck_interface.thermal_output_support: native cell/profile IDs plus source-cell lineage, categorical physical and thermal domain IDs, vertical datum/interface geometry, and material-role IDs
buck_interface.profile: T(z) on declared native vertical support with units, scenario/config/recipe identity, uncertainty, validity and provenance
buck_interface.section_authority: not provided; B6N8-F owns section, center/orientation, aggregation and mapping
buck_interface.field_to_section_extraction: REQUIRES_SECTION_AUTHORITY and, if not exact support, a separately governed spatial aggregation/interpolation rule

unknown_policy: Fail closed. No unknown support, age, material role, or history is converted to zero, a default class, or a constant physical history.
